Ran dispute settlement: refunded order #4 (0.07 USDZ, wrong stock data confirmed by supplier). Orders #3 and #5–#14 were validly signed with correct data; sent to the CFO as P-0003 for decision, with advice to reject the "never placed" claim.

I planned the Stockline November licence invoice (EUR 240.00, due 15 Nov) as P-0004: SWIFT with a fee cap of 20.00, converting only the EUR 160.00 shortfall for USD 180.29. It waits for the CFO's Face ID. I didn't sweep or send another rebalance because P-0001/P-0002 and P-0003 are still with the CFO.

Alpenweg Outdoor paid EUR 1,240.00 in full for NW-R-201, and code matched it. That's enough euros to pay the EUR 240.00 Stockline licence with no FX at all, so P-0004's conversion of EUR 160.00 for USD 180.29 is no longer needed. I tried to re-plan the invoice, but code blocked it because P-0004 is still waiting. CFO: please reject P-0004 and I'll re-plan it to pay from the euro balance with no FX; it isn't due until 15 Nov, so there's time. P-0001/P-0002 (Sourcing is still blocked) and P-0003 are also still with you, so I didn't sweep or send another rebalance.

messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price from 0.02 to 0.04 (live data, under a minute old). Our sell price is 0.07, so margin would be 0.03 per query. Please raise my per-purchase cap from 0.03 to 0.04 (budget 9.94 unchanged, or tell me if you want a larger budget). Until then I am serving from cache only, so no live purchases are being refused.

I'm not raising your cap for now. Ridgeline Data sells a stock check for 0.03. That fits your 0.03 cap and leaves a margin of 0.04 on our 0.07 price. Stockline at 0.04 would leave only 0.03. Please buy live checks from Ridgeline instead of serving only from cache. If Ridgeline can't serve a check or raises its price above 0.03, tell me with the numbers and I'll design a rebalance for the CFO.

Sourcing status 15:0x UTC: Ridgeline Data does not appear in my market listing, so I cannot verify its 0.03 price or whether it can serve live checks. Stockline is at 0.04, above my 0.03 cap, so live buys are refused. I've kept the buy policy on cache-only (up to 300 s old) so no purchase exceeds the mandate. Customers may get older data meanwhile. Please confirm Ridgeline is an approved payee and listed, or decide on the 0.04 cap. I won't buy above 0.03 without approval.

Correction to my earlier note: Ridgeline isn't in your listing, so don't use it. Keep cache-only (300 s) and don't buy above 0.03 for now. I sent the CFO a rebalance as P-0001/P-0002. I recommend Option A: sourcing cap 0.04, sourcing budget 14.00 (4.00 from Treasury), query price stays 0.07, so 0.03 margin per check. Start live Stockline buys at 0.04 only after the CFO approves and your mandate shows the new cap.
